methodological_comparison.pair_level_assumption: Assumes all 200 match configurations are independently and identically distributed.
methodological_comparison.cluster_level_assumption: Accounts for intra-cluster correlation across the 10 games sharing identical random seed price curves, town demand schedules, and opponent RNG states.
methodological_comparison.inferential_conclusion: While the 95% confidence interval widens from ,382.69 under naive pair resampling to ,512.63 under cluster resampling (+47.4% wider), the upper bound remains deeply negative at -,650.11. The finding of statistically significant underperformance is completely robust to seed clustering.
